_comment: Shenzhen Hospital CXR Set — NLM/Shenzhen No.3 People's Hospital TB screening dataset. 662 frontal chest X-rays (336 TB, 326 normal) captured at out-patient clinics using a Philips DR Digital Diagnose system. Binary TB label is encoded directly in the filename suffix (_0 = normal, _1 = TB), so there is no separate label CSV. Clinical metadata (patient age, sex, findings description) is distributed as individual text files in ClinicalReadings/. The dataset has no primary CSV; the harmonizer scans CXR_png/ to build the DataFrame. Download from: https://data.lhncbc.nlm.nih.gov/public/Tuberculosis-Chest-X-ray-Datasets/Shenzhen-Hospital-CXR-Set/index.html

primary_csv._comment: No primary CSV — the dataset has no metadata spreadsheet. The harmonizer scans base_image_dir for PNG files matching CHNCXR_*_*.png and builds the DataFrame from filenames.

patient_id._comment: Derived from the numeric portion of the filename. CHNCXR_0001_1.png → patient_id = '0001'. One patient per study in this dataset.
patient_id.derivation: 4-digit zero-padded numeric portion of the PNG filename, e.g. '0001' from CHNCXR_0001_1.png

study_id._comment: Same as patient_id — each patient has exactly one study in this dataset.

image_path._comment: Filename only (e.g. CHNCXR_00001_1.png). base_image_dir is CXR_png/, so image_path is just the filename — no prefix needed.
image_path.derivation: Filename of the PNG file, e.g. CHNCXR_00001_1.png

labels._comment: Single binary TB label derived from the filename suffix: _0 = 0 (normal), _1 = 1 (tuberculosis).

separate_csv._comment: Label is embedded in the filename — no separate label file.

uncertain_handling._comment: Binary 0/1 label with no uncertainty; NaN not applicable.

view_position._comment: All images are frontal CXRs; no view-position column in the dataset.

masks._comment: Annotations-2/masks/ has 1 PNG for each finding region of a TB image. With mask_output_dir, the harmonizer joins them into 1 TB region mask for each image (D-33, D-35).

bboxes._comment: Not provided in a structured format compatible with the RadHarmony bbox pipeline.

reports._comment: Clinical readings (age, sex, findings text) are in ClinicalReadings/CHNCXR_#####_0/1.txt. They are loaded as the 'report' column when clinical_readings_dir is set on the harmonizer.

separate_csv._comment: No CSV — one text file per image in ClinicalReadings/.

extra_init_params.clinical_readings_dir: Optional path to the ClinicalReadings/ directory. When set, the harmonizer reads each CHNCXR_#####_0/1.txt file and populates patient_age, patient_sex, and report columns.

custom_preprocessing: No primary CSV — harmonizer scans base_image_dir for PNG files. TB label is parsed from the filename suffix (_0=normal, _1=TB). Clinical metadata is loaded from ClinicalReadings/ text files when clinical_readings_dir is provided.

expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Sources: NLM-ChinaCXRSet-ReadMe.docx (662 images: 336 TB, 326 normal), and the raw files read with Python: the CXR_png/ file names and the first line of each ClinicalReadings/*.txt file. The first line has the sex and the age, for example 'male 35yrs'. 'femal' (3 files) is female. 2 ages are in months and 1 in days. The harmonizer converts them to years. One file (CHNCXR_0018_0) says 'male 42' with no unit, so its age is NaN (D-06). Each image number is one patient and one study.
